newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Marubeni offers to buy Philippine turbines.
newsitem.headline: Marubeni offers to buy Philippine turbines.

text.p: Marubeni Corp had offered to buy two 501F gas turbines from the Philippines' National Power Corp (Napocor) at an unspecified amount, a Napocor official said on Thursday.

The gas turbines, which have a capacity to produce 161 megawatts of power each, were given by Westinghouse Electric Corp as part of its settlement with the Philippine government over a dispute on the construction of a nuclear plant north of Manila.
The official said Marubeni wanted to buy the turbines for its power project in Colombia.
He said Napocor will not settle for a price lower than $60 million for the two turbines.
